name: SignInPanel
description: Mortar sign-in surface with provider buttons and email link form; auth SDKs supply callbacks.

props.title: string
props.providers: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; onSelect: () => void }[]
props.email: { onSubmit: (email: string) => void; label?; placeholder?; submitLabel?; status?: "idle" | "submitting" | "success" | "error"; message? }

contract.usage: Import { SignInPanel } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Use it for a passwordless sign-in (providers plus an emailed link) as a section, for example inside a landing page with headingLevel={2}. It renders ProviderButtons and a labelled Divider. For a dedicated sign-in page, or any flow with passwords or codes, compose AuthLayout with ProviderButtons, PasswordInput and CodeInput instead (docs/auth-flows.md).
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
